description: This file declares validation functions for various 3GPP radio configuration parameters related to serving cell configurations in a scheduler, including PDCCH, PDSCH, PUCCH, PUSCH, SRS, NZP-CSI-RS, and CSI-MeasConfig.
external_methods: validator_result validate_pucch_cfg(const serving_cell_config&, const std::vector<pucch_resource>&, const pucch_config_common&, unsigned)
validator_result validate_csi_meas_cfg(const serving_cell_config&, const std::optional<tdd_ul_dl_config_common>&, const ul_config_common&)

methods.name: validate_pdcch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PDCCH configuration in UE serving cell config, returns error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_pdsch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PDSCH configuration in UE serving cell config, returns error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_pucch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PUCCH configuration with resource list and common config, returns error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_pusch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PUSCH uplink configuration, considering CSI enablement, returns error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_srs_cfg
methods.description: Validates SRS configuration in UE serving cell, based on UL BWP CRB interval, returns error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_nzp_csi_rs_list
methods.description: Validates NZP-CSI-RS resource list with optional TDD config, returns error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_csi_meas_cfg
methods.description: Validates CSI measurement configuration with optional TDD config, returns error message if invalid.

calls: validator_result validate_pucch_cfg(const serving_cell_config&, const std::vector<pucch_resource>&, const pucch_config_common&, unsigned)
validator_result validate_csi_meas_cfg(const serving_cell_config&, const std::optional<tdd_ul_dl_config_common>&, const ul_config_common&)
